message:
Now I see the vulnerability. In `p2p_copy_client_info`:
```c
dev->info.wps_sec_dev_type_list_len = 8 * cli->num_sec_dev_types;
os_memcpy(dev->info.wps_sec_dev_type_list, cli->sec_dev_types,
          dev->info.wps_sec_dev_type_list_len);
```

The `wps_sec_dev_type_list` is a fixed-size array. Let me check its size in p2p.h:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜=command>sed -n '370,400p' /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/hostap/src/p2p/p2p.h && echo "---" && sed -n '500,520p' /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/hostap/src/p2p/p2p.h</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
